purpose: Define optional emission of inert Events from runtime error/failure transitions before any alerting or automated recovery.

topics.name: Failure to Event Boundary
topics.purpose: Define optional emission of inert Events from runtime error/failure transitions before any alerting or automated recovery.

semantics.binding_rule: Which failures emit Events is explicit.
semantics.event_rule: Emitted Event has its own identity and references exact error/execution/resource.
semantics.payload_rule: Failure Event payload is inert and redaction-governed.
semantics.dedupe_rule: Repeated observation of same unresolved failure does not emit uncontrolled duplicate transition Events.
semantics.authority_rule: Failure Event never grants repair authority.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.

references.purpose: Failures may emit distinct inert Events.
